name: memory.update
description: Revise an existing memory. Writes a new version and supersedes the old one (which stays visible in history). Use this tool ONLY when the user has explicitly asked to update or correct a memory entry (e.g., 'update what you remember about X', 'change my recorded preference for Y'). The post-turn extractor handles routine refinement automatically. Pass scope='long_term' or scope='workspace' (workspace_id auto-resolved). Body / importance both optional; pass only what you want to change.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: New body. If omitted, body is unchanged.
